Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment analyzes the protein corona (PC) formed on gold nanoparticles. While the PC itself is a form of enrichment (proteins adsorbed to NPs), it does not map to the specific PTM-based or specialized ontology modifiers provided in the guidance (like phospho or ubiquitin). Quantification was performed using a relative abundance based on peptide counts (spectral counting), which falls under LFQ.

organism: Human plasma from a healthy donor was procured
noncellular_sources: Human plasma with the K2 EDTA anticoagulant was purchased
scope: The recovered NPs were washed in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) three times to remove the unbound and soft corona
the proteins associated with the NPs and their relative abundance were analyzed by LC-MS/MS
the proteins identified from LC-MS/MS were queried into STRING software as a group to map the protein–protein interactions in the protein corona

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on the protein corona (PC) isolated from gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) after incubation in human plasma. The material analyzed by MS was the purified protein complex (the corona) recovered from the nanoparticles via centrifugation and washing, not the whole plasma or the macrophages used in subsequent assays.
